tower_pro_organization.organization: 715 imported CAD face patches consolidated into 9 selectable exterior sections. Only exactly coincident boundary vertices were welded.
tower_pro_organization.geometry_comparison: All oriented face coordinates match pre-edit recovery at 0.00001 mm rounding; smooth flags and materials retained.
tower_pro_organization.limitations: Source is one continuous exterior shell. Housing interfaces are open surfaces: no internal walls, motor, gears or full fasteners provided. Not printable replacement housing parts.
